description: Read the saved BTC Daily Brief and its evidence cutoff. Pin report_id and use JSON pointer paths to inspect the exact edition.

offset.description: Entry offset for a paged path.

path.description: Omit for the brief overview; pass an empty string for the full report root or a JSON pointer such as /brief/cards. Escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1.

report_id.description: Exact report_id returned by this tool; required for expansion.

name: get_daily_brief
title: Bitcoin Daily Brief
